Organization.title: Organization
Organization.description: Root retail tenant organization with tax, currency, and receipt configuration.

Branch.title: Branch
Branch.description: Individual retail branch belonging to an organization.

User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated staff profile with role, assigned branches, and permission overrides.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Dynamic RBAC role containing configurable permission identifiers.

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: Administrator-controlled user invitation with pre-assigned role and branches.

BranchInventory.title: BranchInventory
BranchInventory.description: Branch-specific inventory quantity and pricing record.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Payment breakdown record linked to a sale.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Customer profile for loyalty and purchase history.

Purchase.title: Purchase
Purchase.description: Branch purchase order and supplier invoice record.

Refund.title: Refund
Refund.description: Customer return and refund request tied to a sale.

CashSession.title: CashSession
CashSession.description: Cash register shift session for a cashier in a branch.

CashSessionTransaction.title: CashSessionTransaction
CashSessionTransaction.description: Deposit, withdrawal, sale, or refund cash ledger entry inside /cashSessions/{sessionId}/transactions.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable security and operational audit record.

BranchDailySummary.title: BranchDailySummary
BranchDailySummary.description: Aggregated daily branch financial and sales snapshot.

SystemSettings.title: SystemSettings
SystemSettings.description: Organization-wide POS, receipt, payment, discount, refund, and approval policy settings.

receiptVisibleFields.description: Configured order receipt sections/records enabled for print and PDF output.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Targeted branch/organization alert for low stock, approvals, and transfers.

IdempotencyKey.title: IdempotencyKey
IdempotencyKey.description: Deduplication record ensuring duplicate sales or financial submissions cannot execute twice.

Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description: SaaS tenant retail business record linked to its active plan, subscription, and branding.

TenantMembership.title: TenantMembership
TenantMembership.description: Authoritative user-to-tenant membership mapping role and branch assignments.

PosTerminal.title: PosTerminal
PosTerminal.description: Registered POS terminal/register belonging to a branch for terminal quota enforcement.

SubscriptionPlan.title: SubscriptionPlan
SubscriptionPlan.description: Configurable SaaS subscription package definition with pricing, limits, and feature flags.

TenantSubscription.title: TenantSubscription
TenantSubscription.description: Tenant subscription lifecycle record including trial, billing period, grace period, and pending plan changes.

SubscriptionPayment.title: SubscriptionPayment
SubscriptionPayment.description: Server-verified Paystack, Mobile Money, or manual subscription billing transaction record.

UsageTracking.title: UsageTracking
UsageTracking.description: Real-time tenant resource counters for branches, terminals, staff, and products.

FeatureOverride.title: FeatureOverride
FeatureOverride.description: Time-bound feature or quota override granted to a tenant by a Platform Super Admin.

PlatformAdmin.title: PlatformAdmin
PlatformAdmin.description: Authorized SaaS platform owner or billing/support administrator.

SupportTicket.title: SupportTicket
SupportTicket.description: Tenant support request managed via the Platform Super Admin console.

/branches/{branchId}.description: Retail branches owned by an organization.

/users/{userId}.description: Staff accounts, role assignments, branch access, and permission overrides.

/roles/{roleId}.description: Dynamic RBAC roles and permission lists.

/invitations/{invitationId}.description: Pending and accepted administrator-issued staff invitations.

/branchInventory/{inventoryId}.description: Branch-specific product stock quantities and prices.

/systemSettings/{settingId}.description: Organization-wide system settings and receipt templates.

/tenants/{tenantId}.description: SaaS tenant business profiles and active plan/subscription pointers.

/subscriptionPayments/{paymentId}.description: Server-verified Paystack & Mobile Money billing transactions.

/featureOverrides/{overrideId}.description: Temporary tenant feature and quota overrides.
